newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bremen coffee prices quietly lower.
newsitem.headline: Bremen coffee prices quietly lower.

text.p: Bremen arabica prices were off $4-10 on the week per 50 kg fob in line with futures in a quiet summer market, traders said.
Coffee roasters baulked at the premium of New York July and September arabica futures over December and tried to price cash purchases against the latter contract.
Brazils cost $155 for September shipment, which was down $4 from last Friday, basis second hand, because origin shippers had difficulty pushing exports due to the firm domestic market.
In robustas, Indonesians stayed relatively firm at $82.50 cif while African sellers reduced differentials.
